integrity: The proof derives the exact conditional lower and upper truncated means, converts the affine regression into an integral equation for the quantile, differentiates to a first-order ODE, and enforces monotonicity and integrability. The packaged checker verifies the ODE solution and regression identity independently; finite numerical checks are supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Central symmetry is assumed; the full nonsymmetric affine-regression problem is not classified.
The proof uses an absolutely continuous parent with positive continuous density, differentiable strictly increasing quantile, and finite first moment.

The family may have alternative parameterizations in the distribution-characterization literature; originality is limited to the stated regression equivalence, sharp slope floor, and tail-index consequence.
title: Affine conditional midrange regression characterizes a symmetric power-quantile family
